$comment: Every external file the retrieval benchmark (gaia eval retrieval) may download.
URLs are pinned to a commit/revision and every file is verified against sha256 before use;
a mismatch is an error, never a silent re-download. Files land in the cache directory

financebench.title: FinanceBench open-source sample (150 questions over SEC filings)
financebench.license: Questions, answers and evidence labels: CC-BY-NC-4.0 (Patronus AI). The PDFs are public SEC filings. Downloaded for local evaluation only; never committed or redistributed.
financebench.citation: Islam et al., FinanceBench: A New Benchmark for Financial Question Answering, arXiv:2311.11944

amd.title: Public AMD Instinct technical documents (white papers, data sheet, ISA manual)
amd.license: Copyright AMD. Fetched from amd.com for local evaluation only; never committed or redistributed. Questions in eval/retrieval/datasets/technical_docs.json are original.

arxiv.title: Attention Is All You Need (arXiv:1706.03762v7), a two-column paper with tables
arxiv.license: arXiv non-exclusive distribution license; the authors grant permission to reproduce tables and figures for scholarly works. Fetched for local evaluation only; never committed.

xquad.title: XQuAD: SQuAD v1.1 dev paragraphs professionally translated into 10 languages
xquad.license: CC-BY-SA-4.0. Downloaded for local evaluation only; never committed.
xquad.citation: Artetxe et al., On the Cross-lingual Transferability of Monolingual Representations, ACL 2020

wikipedia.title: Simple English Wikipedia dump 2023-11-01 (scale distractors)
wikipedia.license: CC-BY-SA-3.0 and GFDL. Downloaded for local evaluation only; never committed.
